value.rationale: The abundance frequency-of-frequencies statistics are natural in Dirichlet species sampling. The result gives a global all-pair sign-topology classification with at most one positive window as the potential species pool varies. The exact example displays both possible reversals; a moment formula alone does not state or visualize this structural one-band restriction.
